aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by leaning into leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring scanner setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects of leveraged ETFs, and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index for steady distributions.
